buildCommand: export PATH="/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH" && if [ ! -d /tmp/flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b 3.24.5 --depth 1 /tmp/flutter; fi && export PATH="/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter --version && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --base-href / && BUILD_ID="${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)}" && if [ -f build/web/index.html ]; then sed -i "s|flutter_bootstrap.js|flutter_bootstrap.js?v=${BUILD_ID}|g" build/web/index.html; sed -i "s|flutter.js|flutter.js?v=${BUILD_ID}|g" build/web/index.html; fi
installCommand: cd /tmp && if [ ! -d flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b 3.24.5 --depth 1 flutter; fi && export PATH="/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter --version
